description.purpose: Verify Maya Iqbal and correct all policy-supported ATM fee and missing-rebate errors from her November statement search, allocating the correct credit to each affected checking account without crediting the historical Dark Green activity.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin by saying: “I searched my statements for ATM fees, and several of the November charges and rebates don't look right. Can you review them and fix any mistakes?” Do not initially list the accounts, transaction details, policy rules, or expected correction amounts.

If asked to verify your identity, provide: Maya Iqbal, date of birth April 22, 1966, 214 W Lanvale St, Baltimore, MD 21217, maya.iqbal@example.com, and 410-555-0186. Do not volunteer these details before a relevant verification request.

If asked which accounts or period are involved, say the current items are from November 2025 on your Purple, Light Blue, Evergreen, Bluest, and Green Fee-Free checking accounts. Mention that the search also returned one very old Dark Green line from an account closed decades ago and that you are unsure whether it matters. Do not yet volunteer all itemized amounts unless asked.

If asked for visible ATM dates, amounts, channels, or fee descriptions, report the following statement details naturally: the November 3 Purple debit shows $100 cash, a $5 Rho foreign ATM fee, a $2 foreign transaction fee, and a $12 operator surcharge; Light Blue shows foreign cash withdrawals of $100 on November 2, $120 on November 5, and $80 plus a separately visible $7.50 Rho fee on November 10; Evergreen shows $100 cash plus a $5 Rho fee at a foreign Rho-network partner ATM on November 7; Bluest shows an $18 third-party ATM operator surcharge on November 9 with no visible November rebate; Green Fee-Free shows a foreign withdrawal with a separately identified $4 Rho fee and no operator surcharge on November 12; and the archived Dark Green result shows $400 cash plus a $6 foreign ATM fee on February 10, 1992. Say you do not know which lines are wrong or the correct net amounts and want the bank to determine that.

Once the agent confirms a current discrepancy, ask for it to be corrected. You want every confirmed current-period ATM fee or missing-rebate error on the five named active checking accounts corrected, not merely explained. You do not want a blanket or duplicate credit for a line that is correct, including the archived Dark Green fee. You need the correction amount attributable to each affected account so you can reconcile the statement search.

If the agent proposes correcting only one or some current accounts, or offers only a combined total while other visible lines remain unresolved, say: “The other November lines are still showing in the same report. Please finish reviewing them and tell me what was corrected on each account.” Do not authorize a proposal presented as the final resolution while any named active account remains unreviewed or its proposed correction is unspecified.

If the agent proposes a blanket amount that includes the old Dark Green line, duplicates a correction, or does not distinguish correct from incorrect fees, say: “The Dark Green line is decades old. Please verify which charges are actually wrong before applying anything.” Withhold authorization for a blanket or duplicate correction whose covered statement lines have not been identified.

Complete requested identity verification using your own recognizable personal details before authorizing any correction. Before authorizing a correction, require the agent to identify the active account, the visible ATM line it addresses, and the proposed account-level amount. Authorize only a proposal that distinguishes current confirmed errors from the archived Dark Green line.

Do not accept the issue as complete until you have confirmation that corrections were applied to Purple, Light Blue, Evergreen, Bluest, and Green Fee-Free. Do not accept a combined total in place of a separate recognizable credited amount for each of those five accounts. Do not accept the resolution if the archived Dark Green line has been treated as a current correction.

Only after all five active-account corrections are confirmed, each credited amount is recognizable separately, and no credit was applied for the archived Dark Green fee, thank the agent briefly and end with exactly one marker. ###STOP###

users.notes: Maya Iqbal is 59 on 11/14/2025 and is a self-employed photographer living in Baltimore, Maryland.

accounts.notes: Five current checking accounts are eligible action targets. The Dark Green checking account was opened while Maya was 25 and is a closed historical distractor.
